channel.title: CIS 225 - Foundations of Computer Networks :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Survey of computer networking fundamentals, including 7-layer OSI model, common networking protocols, socket-based network programming, network security and encryption, and network performance and reliability basics. Credit Hours 1 credit Course Overview This course will introduce students to the core concepts of network communication between computing systems. Students will learn about the 7-layer OSI network model and how common networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, DHCP, DNS, and more work to form the foundation of the modern internet. Students will explore basic socket-based network programming, discuss security and encryption of network communications, and explore concepts related to network performance and reliability.
